verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has a founder-oriented O-1 resource saying founders can apply if they show extraordinary ability, and it mentions filing through an agent instead of an employer. Neither documents how a founder's own startup can act as petitioner, so they are adjacent at most and earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation of the founder's startup as petitioning employer, beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements (employer-employee relationship), and coverage of the 2023+ USCIS founder/entrepreneur guidance.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents how my own startup can petition for me — beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance
